name: kal
description: Search a personal knowledge DB (Kallimachos) — retrieval over MCP, with the source and the timeline attached.

vault_dir.title: Vault path
vault_dir.description: Absolute path to the note root to index.  Everything matching **/*.md under it is read (read-only).

kal_dir.title: Knowledge DB location
kal_dir.description: Where LanceDB and the cache live.  Usually ~/.kal.  Indexing has to be run once first.

run_as.title: Container uid:gid
run_as.description: It has to be able to read the mounted folders.  The default works on macOS; on Linux your own values are needed —— check with `id -u`:`id -g`.
